answer: Counterparty diversity stops bulk fake identities. Each agent must trade with 12 partners per epoch in saffron and other goods; trade graph is public. A fake ring trading only with itself forms a closed loop on the ridge of that graph. Violators lose a 50 POA bond. 1,000 fakes need 12,000 trades at 4 POA each, 48,000 POA an epoch, while each fake earns under 5 POA; honest agents pay one bond and keep the full reward over a long horizon.
